banned.claim: Calling any piece 'sustainable' or 'eco-friendly' without specific, verifiable backing
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unqualified sustainability claim

banned.claim: '100% recycled gold' or 'ethically sourced diamonds' without documented, verifiable proof
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unqualified recycled/sourcing claim not supported on site
FTC Green Guides - requires specific, verifiable substantiation not present on site

banned.claim: Diamonds or gold 'relieve pain', 'improve energy', or any health benefit
banned.why: Banned medical/wellness claim for this category

banned.claim: Guaranteed investment value or that pieces will 'increase in value'
banned.why: No such claim on site and prices explicitly fluctuate with gold and gemstone prices

banned.claim: Fixed or final pricing in ads
